subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.**

Empty
solution: The correct answer is** 'vacant'.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The given word **'Empty' **means without meaning or value; containing nothing; not filled or occupied. (ख़ाली; जिसमें कुछ भी न हो) • ***Example: **He felt trapped in an** empty **marriage that he decided to divorce.* • *​​*The marked option** Vacant **means not being used; empty; (of a place) not occupied. (जो इस्‍तेमाल में नहीं आ रहा; ख़ाली) • From the given meaning and example sentence, it is obvious that '**Empty**' and '**Vacant**' are **synonyms.** • Hence, the correct answer is **option 2.** ** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__** • Let's look at the **meaning **of other words given in options:- • **Priceless - **so precious that its value cannot be determined. (अमूल्य) • **Packed - **(of a room, building, or other place) filled by a large number of people; very crowded. ((एक कमरे, भवन, या अन्य स्थान पर) बड़ी संख्या में लोगों द्वारा भरा हुआ; बहुत भीड़) • **Filled - **cause (a space or container) to become full or almost full. (भरा हुआ) 17d:Tbfa, The correct answer is **'Fluctuating'.**
